notes: Account summary: mid-market analytics SaaS with 400 engineers+product/ops users. Primary value: in-app assistant & faster triage for support agents.

Security posture: pursuing SOC2 Type II, must have SSO (SAML), audit logs accessible to their security team, and KMS integration for key control.
Asked about data residency for EU customers — needs option to pin region and keep logs for 12 months.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18 call: 'We like the model performance but need a clear path to VPC/Dedicated for compliance and predictable costs.'

Current stance: prefer Hosted for quick launch (internal pilot), but enterprise customers require Dedicated in VPC before full rollout.
SE feedback: run targeted benchmark with their typical prompt mix (short chat + long context summarization) on a dedicated pool; provide recommended batching/quant profiles.
Action items added: send Dedicated pricing, SOC2 artifacts, architecture diagram for VPC peering; set up security review meeting week of 2026-03-08.
